description: This file defines the PHP class TemplateGroupChooser, which extends the Template class. It primarily provides a method to generate HTML and JavaScript code for a customizable group chooser widget with dual or triple list boxes for selecting groups, including navigation arrows and optional tabs. The class is used within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment for rendering UI components.

classes.name: TemplateGroupChooser
classes.description: A PHP class for rendering a dynamic group chooser widget with multiple list boxes and control arrows.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript code to display the group chooser widget with configurable options and visual layout.
